cookbooks.title: Semantic Cache Backend with Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Configure Valkey as the vLLM Semantic Router cache backend so repeated or paraphrased prompts return instantly with an HNSW vector index, KNN lookup, and TTL eviction.

cookbooks.title: Vector Store Backend with Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Use Valkey as the RAG vector store backend with per-collection FT indexes, KNN search filtered by file_id TAG, and batch chunk ingestion via valkey-glide.

cookbooks.title: Agentic Memory Backend with Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Back the router's agentic memory with Valkey for per-user vector recall, hybrid reranking, access tracking, and TLS-secured production deployments.
